notes.title: AMA | PARADISE — GAMEPLAY + LIVE CHAT WITH NPCs!
notes.notes:
📢 Today – AMA | PARADISE — GAMEPLAY + LIVE CHAT WITH NPCs! 🎙

We invite you to a special AMA session celebrating the release of PARADISE, where we will demonstrate how our AI NPCs work in real-time! 🔥 

The game release is just around the corner, but for now, you can watch the gameplay live.

💥 What to expect:

- Live gameplay showcase featuring AI NPCs in action – ask any questions to our characters and receive real-time answers!

- Discussion about the game release, details about mechanics, and future plans.

- Interaction with developers and answers to community questions.

📅 When: 30 March
🕒 Time: 18:00 UTC
📍 Where: YouTube & Steam

Don't miss the launch of PARADISE and the unique opportunity to learn about the project firsthand! 🚀
